biography.plain_text: Samark José López Bello is a Venezuelan businessman who acquired control of Profit Corporation, an engineering contractor serving the oil and gas industry. His companies supplied state enterprises including PDVSA, while Postar Intertrade expanded into food imports and building materials. His business interests extended through companies in Venezuela and Barbados.

long_biography.plain_text:
Samark López Bello, a Venezuelan contractor trained in economics, first established Sertica to renovate industrial plants. He had studied at the Central University of Venezuela and worked in planning and budgeting for Mérida's regional government. His later investments included Agropecuaria Bubalis, where he assembled farmland and developed livestock and crop production near the town where he grew up.

In 2017, the United States imposed sanctions on López Bello for allegedly supporting Tareck El Aissami's narcotics-trafficking activities. He denied involvement in drug trafficking and challenged the designation. A federal appeals court rejected that challenge in 2024. That year, Venezuelan authorities also arrested him in an investigation into alleged corruption at PDVSA.
